title: issue-flow config (.agents/flow.json)
description: Every key is optional; a missing one takes its default. Unknown keys are an error.

repo.description: owner/repo. By default, -R, then GH_REPO, then the checkout's origin.

baseBranch.description: Branch the work starts from and PRs target. By default, the repo's default branch.

template.description: Name of an issue's branch. Needs {number} and {slug}; {type} is optional.

namer.description: Who names a branch when the issue has no usable "Slug de rama" block: Claude (falls back to the title) or the title.

types.description: Branch type of an issue: by label first, then by title prefix (case-insensitive). Each map given replaces its default whole.

dir.description: Where issue worktrees go, relative to the repo root.

commitMessage.description: Message of the empty commit that starts an issue; {number} is the issue. [skip ci] keeps CI from running on a commit with no changes.
commitMessage.default: chore: empieza el trabajo en la issue #{number} [skip ci]

prBody.description: Body of the draft PR; {keyword} is Closes, or Part of when the issue has another live branch.

prompt.description: Prompt Claude opens with on a new branch; {number}, {title} (text anyone can write in the issue: better left out).
prompt.default: Issue #{number}. Lee la issue con `npx github-rest issue view {number}`, resúmela en lenguaje llano y sigue la skill start-issue para elegir el flujo.

resumePrompt.description: Prompt Claude opens with on a branch that has a plan; {number}, {title} (text anyone can write in the issue: better left out), {plan}.
resumePrompt.default: Issue #{number}. Lee la issue con `npx github-rest issue view {number}`, resúmela en lenguaje llano y retoma el trabajo según {plan}: revisa qué tareas quedan.

summaryPrompt.description: Prompt of --plan: only summarize and wait; {number}, {title} (text anyone can write in the issue: better left out).
summaryPrompt.default: Issue #{number}. Lee la issue con `npx github-rest issue view {number}` y resúmela en lenguaje llano. No empieces a trabajar ni a planificar: espera mi pedido.

summaryPlanPrompt.description: Prompt of --plan when the issue has an open plan; {number}, {title} (text anyone can write in the issue: better left out), {plan}.
summaryPlanPrompt.default: Issue #{number}. Lee la issue con `npx github-rest issue view {number}` y resúmela en lenguaje llano. Tiene un plan abierto en {plan}: di en una línea qué tareas quedan. No empieces a trabajar ni a planificar: espera mi pedido.

cloudPrompt.description: What --cloud asks the cloud session: the skill that starts the issue there with --here; {number}, and {flags} (' --new' or ' --resume <branch>' when the branch was chosen here).

dirs.description: Folders where an issue's plan is looked for, relative to the repo, in order of preference.

colors.description: Session color by label prefix; the first entry that starts a label wins. Replaces the default whole.
